description: Searches entity grants with the specified criteria and pagination.

entityId.description: The entity Id to search for grants on.

name.description: The name of the entity grant to search for. Supports wildcard search using *.

numberOfResults.description: The number of results to return. Defaults to 25.

orderBy.description: The field to order the results by.

startRow.description: The offset into the total results. Defaults to 0.

userId.description: The user Id to search for grants on.

name: searchEntityGrantsByParametersWithId
